title: packaging
content:
Packaging Services: How We Protect Your Parcel

Good packaging helps reduce the risk of damage during international transportation. Before shipping, Hiobuy can consolidate your items and select suitable packaging based on the product type, weight, size and shipping requirements.

Standard Packaging

Standard packaging may include:

  • Carton boxes
  • Protective bags
  • Basic filling materials
  • Sealing tape
  • Shipping labels

Our warehouse team will remove unnecessary outer packaging when appropriate and arrange the items efficiently to reduce excess volume.

Parcel Consolidation

When products from different sellers arrive at the warehouse, you can combine them into one international parcel.

Consolidation may help you:

  • Reduce the number of international shipments
  • Organize multiple orders more easily
  • Remove unnecessary seller packaging
  • Make better use of the parcel space

However, combining too many heavy or fragile products may increase the risk of damage. In some cases, we may recommend splitting the shipment into multiple parcels.

Optional Reinforcement Services

Depending on availability, you may request additional packaging services such as:

  • Bubble wrapping
  • Corner protection
  • Waterproof packaging
  • Reinforced cartons
  • Vacuum packaging
  • Fragile-item protection
  • Removal of shoe boxes or product packaging

Additional services may involve extra charges.

Important Reminder

International parcels pass through multiple transportation and sorting stages. Reinforced packaging can reduce risk, but it cannot completely prevent damage caused by customs inspection, carrier handling or extreme transportation conditions.

Please select appropriate protection for fragile, valuable or easily deformed products.
